Title: Azure Ultra Disk Storage is now available in more regions

Body.Content:
Azure Ultra Disk Storage is now available in Central US, West US, South Central US, US Gov Virginia, France Central, and Japan East. Azure Ultra Disks offers high throughput, high IOPS, and consistent low latency disk storage for Azure Virtual Machines (VMs).

Learn more about Ultra Disk Storage.
